name: ComboBox
summary: A text field with filtered suggestions — pick one of many (a company from the tracker, a stage, a contact) or, with allowsCustomValue, type something new. For more options than a RadioGroup can show; when the user must not type, it is a Select (later). Ships four parts: ComboBox (the field), ComboBoxItem (one option), ComboBoxSection + ComboBoxHeader (a named group).

label.requiredWhen: aria-label is not given. The type union refuses a field with neither.
label.intent: The visible label AND the accessible name of the input. Also names the listbox and the toggle button ('Show suggestions for Company').

aria-label.requiredWhen: label is omitted (the quick-add row, the palette input).

children.intent: Static ComboBoxItem / ComboBoxSection elements, or a render function used with items for dynamic lists. Option text is plain; never a control inside an option.

items.intent: Controlled dynamic collection (the consumer filters, e.g. against the tracker). Omit for static children, which React Aria filters by text with a contains-match.

defaultItems.intent: Uncontrolled dynamic collection; React Aria filters it by text.

selectedKey.intent: Controlled selection. null is 'nothing chosen'. Pair with onSelectionChange.

onSelectionChange.intent: Fires with the chosen option's id, or null when the text no longer matches any option. The value a form submits (formValue='key' by default; 'text' with allowsCustomValue).

inputValue.intent: Controlled text. Pair with onInputChange. Needed by quick-add (the text is parsed) and the palette (the query is echoed).

onInputChange.intent: Fires on every keystroke with the text.

allowsCustomValue.intent: Text that matches no option is kept as the value (quick-add: a new company). Off by default: on blur the text reverts to the selected option, so a form never receives a half-typed value.

menuTrigger.intent: When the list opens: on typing (default), on focus (short known lists, Select-like), or only via the button / Arrow Down (manual — the quick-add row, where suggestions are optional).

emptyMessage.intent: Shown in the list when the filter leaves nothing, so the list never silently vanishes. Not shown when allowsCustomValue and the text is new — the text is the result.

description.intent: Help text under the field, linked by aria-describedby.

errorMessage.intent: Shown when isInvalid. Present in the DOM before it becomes visible (same contract as TextField).

isInvalid.intent: aria-invalid + the invalid style; the form decides validity.

isRequired.intent: aria-required + the visible marker. Native required is not used (ADR-022).

isReadOnly.intent: Focusable and announced; neither typing nor the list.

disabledKeys.intent: Options shown but not selectable, skipped by the arrows (e.g. a stage the role cannot move to yet).

placeholder.intent: Example value only, muted. Never the label.

size.intent: Field heights 40 / 44 px (size.target.lg / size.target.touch), same as TextField.

ComboBoxItem.id.intent: The option's id, reported by onSelectionChange. For static children it is required; for items it comes from the object.

ComboBoxItem.textValue.requiredWhen: children is not a plain string.
ComboBoxItem.textValue.intent: The text the filter and type-ahead match on, and what the input shows when chosen.

ComboBoxItem.children.intent: The option's label; optionally a ComboBoxDescription after it.

ComboBoxSection / ComboBoxHeader.intent: A named group of options (palette: Actions · Companies · Contacts · Commands). The header is announced as the group name; it is not an option.

keyboard.action: Filters the options (contains-match on textValue) and opens the list (menuTrigger 'input').
Opens the list if closed; moves the highlighted option (aria-activedescendant). Focus never leaves the input.
Opens the list without highlighting an option.
Move the caret in the text, as in any input (the list uses the arrows).

Selects the highlighted option (text becomes its label, list closes). With allowsCustomValue and no highlight, commits the typed text. Inside a <form> with nothing highlighted and the list closed, submits — the field must not swallow it.
Closes the list; the text stays. Does not propagate to a Modal while the list was open — the first Escape belongs to the list.
Leaves the field and closes the list. Without allowsCustomValue, text that matches no option reverts to the selected option's label (or empties) on blur.

a11y.name: The input is named by label (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the listbox and the toggle button take the same name from React Aria.
a11y.announcements: role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls → the listbox, aria-activedescendant → the highlighted option (focus stays in the input). Options are role="option" with aria-selected; a section header is announced as the group name. React Aria announces the result count on filter ('3 options available') and the empty state is a visible, readable element. isInvalid → aria-invalid="true"; description then error in aria-describedby.
a11y.targetSize: The field is ≥ 40 px tall (44 lg); every option row ≥ 40 px (size.target.lg); the toggle button is a full-height target at the field's end.

rules: The list is NON-modal for assistive technology — the one exception to ADR-029. Focus stays in the input, the highlighted option is conveyed by aria-activedescendant, and the page is not aria-hidden: a combobox is a field the user is typing into, not a surface they moved to.
A ComboBox always lets the user type. If typing makes no sense (3–6 fixed stages), the control is a Select (APG select-only combobox, later) — not a ComboBox with isReadOnly.

No silent empty state: when the filter leaves nothing, the list stays open with emptyMessage, visible and readable. The only exception is allowsCustomValue with new text, where the text itself is the result.
allowsCustomValue is for free text with suggestions (quick-add company, a tag). Off, a half-typed value never reaches the form: on blur the text reverts to the selected option.
Options are plain text (label, optional description). Never a button, link or checkbox inside an option — aria-activedescendant cannot reach it.
The list shows at most 8 rows (calc(8 × size.target.lg) = 320 px), then scrolls; the highlighted option scrolls into view. More than a screen of options is a search, not a list.
Invalid is never colour-only: thicker danger border + error text + aria-invalid (TextField contract, ADR-022). Enter and Escape are never swallowed when the list is closed.
Focus ring is outline + outline-offset on the field box (shared with the toggle button), never box-shadow alone; forced-colors keeps a FieldText border on the box and a CanvasText border on the list.
The popover is positioned by React Aria with the space.200 gap read from the token (useTokenPx, shared Overlay module); it is as wide as the field, never narrower.

properties.State: browser states (default/hover/focus) + open + isInvalid + isDisabled + isReadOnly
properties.Label: label
properties.Error: errorMessage (boolean show + text; visible only when State = invalid)

examples.title: Pick a company from the tracker
Quick-add company: suggestions, but new text is fine
examples.code:
<ComboBox aria-label="Company" allowsCustomValue menuTrigger="manual" inputValue={text} onInputChange={setText} defaultItems={companies}>
  {(c) => <ComboBoxItem id={c.id}>{c.name}</ComboBoxItem>}
</ComboBox>

examples.title: Grouped results
examples.code:
<ComboBox aria-label="Search and commands" items={results}>
  {(group) => (
    <ComboBoxSection id={group.id}>
      <ComboBoxHeader>{group.name}</ComboBoxHeader>
      <Collection items={group.items}>{(r) => <ComboBoxItem id={r.id}>{r.label}</ComboBoxItem>}</Collection>
    </ComboBoxSection>
  )}
</ComboBox>

examples.title: Required on submit
examples.code:
<ComboBox label="Stage" isRequired isInvalid={submitted && !stage} errorMessage="Choose a stage" selectedKey={stage} onSelectionChange={setStage}>
  <ComboBoxItem id="applied">Applied</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem id="screen">Screen</ComboBoxItem>
  <ComboBoxItem id="interview">Interview</ComboBoxItem>
</ComboBox>
